seoTitle: Create a Project Timeline in Smartsheet Easily
metaDescription: Build a visual project timeline in Smartsheet using the Gantt Chart view, adjustable time scales, milestone markers, and color-coded task bars.
intro: A visual timeline makes deadlines and milestones far easier to communicate than a plain list of dates. This guide covers setting up your date columns, activating the Gantt Chart view, adjusting the time scale, and marking key milestones with diamond markers.

steps.heading: Set up your master timeline sheet
steps.body: Create essential tracking columns: Task Name, Start Date, End Date, and Duration.

steps.heading: Activate the Gantt Chart view
steps.body: Turn on and customize the built-in Gantt Chart view for an instant visual timeline.

steps.heading: Adjust the time scale
steps.body: Format the timeline to display by Years, Quarters, Months, or Weeks depending on your project's length.

steps.heading: Color-code your timeline bars
steps.body: Use conditional formatting rules to automatically color bars based on task category, department, or status.

steps.heading: Add milestone markers
steps.body: Set task durations to zero to turn standard timeline bars into clear diamond milestone markers.

faq.question: How do I turn a task list into a visual timeline?
faq.answer: Activating the Gantt Chart view from your project settings converts your task rows into a visual timeline instantly.

faq.question: Can I display my timeline by quarters instead of weeks?
faq.answer: Yes, the timeline's display scale can be adjusted to show Years, Quarters, Months, or Weeks.

faq.question: How do I mark milestones on the timeline?
faq.answer: Setting a task's duration to zero turns its standard bar into a diamond-shaped milestone marker.

faq.question: Can I color-code tasks by department?
faq.answer: Yes, conditional formatting rules let you automatically color timeline bars based on category, department, or status.
